messages.subject: For Lal Karsanbhai | Industrial transformation, sustainability and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Emerson Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Lal Karsanbhai, President and Chief Executive Officer, and the sustainability leadership team.

Emerson's industrial-automation and transformation agenda increasingly depends on disciplined alignment across customers, governments, regulators, sustainability priorities and operating teams. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today inside a major multinational operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, while also supporting governance around a large industrial renewable-energy platform and a carbon-accounting evidence pilot.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of sustainability, government relations, stakeholder strategy and industrial operating experience might support Emerson's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Emerson.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
